## R8/R9 review rows (V02104-R8/R9 wait-guard reviews), one command per line;
## '## ' lines are comments; a 'U:' prefix decodes backslash escapes (\n).
## ---- rows.txt ----
## nested double quotes inside a double-quoted $( )

## literal grep variants that annoy

## stricter rows

## backtick escape

## process subst inside dq subst

## placeholder injection

U:echo \ue000\ue002sleep 5\ue003
U:echo '\ue000(sleep 5)'
